measured: Application calls and optional settings are recorded below at the cited commits.

optional.setting: Configuration: operator instrumentation is a setting that turns the reporting provider on; operator log shipping is enabled by AXIOM_TOKEN/AXIOM_DATASET; default console transport (apps/web/lib/axiom/server.ts:15,31; apps/web/lib/axiom/axiom.ts:3).

backend.call: jobs.invalid_envelope and logger.flush when a job request fails validation

optional.what: API Winston logging with @axiomhq/winston 1.2.0 (js 1.2.0); web next-axiom 0.17.0
optional.setting: Configuration: operator instrumentation is a setting that turns the reporting provider on; operator log shipping adds Axiom to the default console transports only with AXIOM_TOKEN/AXIOM_DATASET (apps/api/v2/src/lib/logger.ts:28-35).

notDemanded: Every Axiom operation but the legacy ingest and the dataset list is outside demand: no application or the bench creates, updates, trims or deletes a dataset, queries (APL or legacy) or reads the current user, and the edge ingest (/v1/ingest/<dataset>) is a separate deployment no pinned client sends to. Dub leaves AXIOM_TOKEN/AXIOM_DATASET blank in apps/web/.env.example:140–141 and selects ConsoleTransport without them (apps/web/lib/axiom/server.ts:15,29–40), so its shipped default sends nothing; the bench supplies both. Cal API leaves both blank in apps/api/v2/.env.example:57–58 and enables Axiom only in apps/api/v2/src/lib/logger.ts:30–35. Cal web next-axiom@0.17.0:dist/platform/generic.js:17–18 requires those variables, and dist/logger.js:197–205 falls back to console when they are absent.

platform.what: The bench runs Dub with its Axiom logging configured (AXIOM_TOKEN and AXIOM_DATASET from the World's credential door); its @axiomhq/logging batches reach the World's Axiom through the legacy ingest, and the bench's evidence adapter reads the stored events as log records.
